title: About Heart Attack Symptoms, Risk, and Recovery
claim_summary: CDC lists chest discomfort, shortness of breath, cold sweat, and jaw, neck, or back discomfort among heart attack warning signs.

title: Warning Signs of a Heart Attack
claim_summary: AHA lists chest discomfort, shortness of breath, cold sweat, and pain or discomfort in the shoulder, back, or arm as warning signs.

title: Venous Thromboembolism - Pulmonary Embolism
claim_summary: NHLBI lists shortness of breath, pain with deep breathing, and coughing up blood among pulmonary embolism symptoms.

title: Heart attack
claim_summary: NHS lists chest pain that can feel crushing or squeezing, spread to the arm, neck, or jaw, shortness of breath, sweating, and immediate action signs.

title: Management of Anaphylaxis at COVID-19 Vaccination Sites
claim_summary: CDC lists throat tightness, stridor, hoarseness, respiratory distress, shortness of breath or wheezing, trouble swallowing or drooling, and swelling of eyes, lips, tongue, mouth, or face among anaphylaxis signs.

title: Anaphylaxis
claim_summary: NHS lists throat or tongue swelling, difficulty breathing, difficulty swallowing, hoarse voice, wheezing, coughing, or noisy breathing as anaphylaxis symptoms or immediate action signs.

title: Guillain-Barre syndrome
claim_summary: WHO describes weakness or tingling that can spread, possible breathing difficulty when chest muscles are affected, and speech or swallowing problems in severe cases.

title: Signs and Symptoms of Stroke
claim_summary: CDC lists sudden numbness or weakness on one side, sudden confusion or trouble speaking, sudden trouble seeing, sudden trouble walking or loss of balance, and sudden severe headache as stroke signs.

title: Subarachnoid haemorrhage caused by a ruptured aneurysm: diagnosis and management
claim_summary: NICE describes thunderclap headache, peaking within 1 to 5 minutes, as a red-flag symptom and recommends urgent assessment when suspected.

title: Headaches in over 12s: diagnosis and management
claim_summary: NICE recommends evaluation and possible investigation or referral for headaches with sudden onset reaching maximum intensity within 5 minutes, new neurological deficit, cognitive dysfunction, impaired consciousness, or other red flags.

title: Vision loss
claim_summary: NHS advises urgent help for changes in vision including flashing lights or dark shadows, and immediate action for sudden inability to see or sudden severe eye pain.

title: Retinal Detachment
claim_summary: NEI lists sudden increase in floaters, flashes of light, and a curtain or shadow over the field of vision as retinal detachment symptoms requiring prompt eye care.

title: Retinal Detachment
claim_summary: AAO EyeWiki describes sudden flashes, floaters, curtain or shadow over vision, and central vision loss as symptoms patients may report with retinal detachment.

title: Meningitis - Symptoms
claim_summary: NHS lists high temperature, headache, stiff neck, dislike of bright lights, sleepiness or difficulty waking, seizures, and rapid worsening among meningitis or sepsis warning symptoms.

title: Abdominal pain - When to see a doctor
claim_summary: Mayo Clinic advises immediate medical attention for abdominal pain with severe pain, fever, bloody stools, persistent nausea and vomiting, severe tenderness, or abdominal swelling.

title: Nausea and vomiting - When to see a doctor
claim_summary: Mayo Clinic advises prompt care for nausea and vomiting with severe abdominal pain, high fever and stiff neck, rectal bleeding, or vomit that contains blood or resembles coffee grounds.

title: Signs and Symptoms of Concussion
claim_summary: CDC advises emergency care after a bump, blow, or jolt to the head when danger signs include seizures, repeated nausea or vomiting, increased confusion, inability to wake, slurred speech, weakness, numbness, or unequal pupils.

title: Head injury and concussion
claim_summary: NHS advises urgent or emergency care after head injury with vomiting, ongoing headache, seizures, difficulty staying awake, numbness or weakness, vision or hearing problems, or problems with walking, balance, understanding, speaking, or writing.

title: Fractures (broken bones): First aid
claim_summary: Mayo Clinic advises emergency help for major trauma, deformity, bone through skin, heavy bleeding, severe pain with gentle movement, and numb or discolored fingers or toes after injury.
